summary: Alibaba Group Holding Limited filed a Form 6-K with the SEC, reporting an announcement made to the Hong Kong Stock Exchange regarding the grant of equity awards under the company's 2024 Plan. On August 22, 2026, the company granted awards involving 1,932,300 underlying shares (approximately 0.01% of total shares issued) to certain employees, with no purchase price and a closing price of HK$123.00 per share. The awards have mixed vesting schedules up to four years, no performance targets, and are subject to clawback provisions. This is a routine equity compensation disclosure, not a special situation transaction.
